in_marathi.name: Surajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of Light

vedic_reference.note: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'सूरजित' (Sūrajit), meaning 'Conquered by the Sun'. It is believed that this name was given to children born when the sun was in a powerful position in the sky.
